detail: evolve-boolean_expressions-186: NameError: name 'choice_match' is not defined; evolve-boolean_expressions-003: NameError: name 'choice_match' is not defined

edits.hypothesis: Explicit instruction that answer must contain ONLY the final value without extra descriptive text will reduce model's tendency to append descriptions (e.g., '(D) Rodrigo' instead of '(D)').
edits.targets_mode: answer format mismatches in shuffled_objects and boolean_expressions where descriptions are appended to choice letters
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Output format specification is most effective via prompt instructions that directly shape generation behavior; the model needs unambiguous specification of required format.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) shuffled_objects-067 ('(D) Rodrigo') and shuffled_objects-023 ('(B) orange ball') would have generated clean answers if format was explicit; (preservative) all 8 passing tasks already output concise answers so clarity will not break them; (transfer) applies to any multi-choice or structured-answer task
edits.regression_risk: Low - emphasizing answer conciseness should not harm sound reasoning; successful tasks generate clean output already
edits.mechanism: Explicit instruction that answer must contain ONLY the final value without extra descriptive text will reduce model's tendency to append descriptions (e.g., '(D) Rodrigo' instead of '(D)').

edits.hypothesis: Using Python tool to robustly extract answers (parse ANSWER: line, isolate choice letter or first token) will strip descriptive text appended by the model, fixing format-based mismatches.
edits.targets_mode: answer extraction where model appends text after core answer despite instructions
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Deterministic parsing of structured output is logic that requires control flow, not prose; a tool provides reliable extraction that cannot be guaranteed via instruction alone.
edits.trigger_condition: Always - every reply processed through extraction
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) regex extraction isolates '(D)' from '(D) Rodrigo' and '(B)' from '(B) orange ball'; (preservative) non-choice answers (linguistics, counting, yes/no) pass through unchanged; (transfer) applicable to any task where model appends extraneous text
edits.regression_risk: Minimal - fallback to last line ensures answer recovery; all tasks instructed to use ANSWER: line
edits.mechanism: Using Python tool to robustly extract answers (parse ANSWER: line, isolate choice letter or first token) will strip descriptive text appended by the model, fixing format-based mismatches.

edits.hypothesis: System prompt guidance to think step-by-step and double-check reasoning will improve accuracy on logic-heavy tasks (web_of_lies, boolean_expressions, causal_understanding) where reasoning errors dominate.
edits.targets_mode: incorrect reasoning and wrong choice selection on logic puzzles and causal problems
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Reasoning quality is shaped by system-level problem-solving guidance; prose in system prompt is the direct lever to improve reasoning habits across task families.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) causal_understanding-099 (wrong causality reasoning) and web_of_lies tasks (logic tracing errors) would benefit from explicit step-by-step guidance; (preservative) 3 passing causal_understanding and 1 passing web_of_lies task already use sound logic and will not regress from encouragement to double-check; (transfer) generalizes to any complex multi-step reasoning task
edits.regression_risk: Low - encouraging careful reasoning strengthens sound paths; minimal token overhead
edits.mechanism: System prompt guidance to think step-by-step and double-check reasoning will improve accuracy on logic-heavy tasks (web_of_lies, boolean_expressions, causal_understanding) where reasoning errors dominate.

mechanism: Add deterministic answer extraction and improve prompt clarity to fix format mismatches and strengthen reasoning guidance
